description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

NBT Bancorp Inc. is hiring a Software Engineer I to build, test, and maintain internal software programs and its participant web portal. The role works on an agile development team under direct supervision and helps improve software solutions and team processes.
Software Engineer I developing, testing, modifying, and documenting software solutions under senior review

Responsibilities:
• 40% - Documents solutions by creating flowcharts, layouts, diagrams, and clear, well-commented code
• 40% - Following our software development lifecycle, develops, tests, and modifies software solutions by analyzing business needs, conferring with users, investigating problem areas, and studying systems flow, data usage, and work processes after review by more senior staff
• 15% - Improves team processes by conducting systems analysis, recommending changes in policies and procedures to increase efficiency
• 5% - Other duties as assigned

Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or Software Engineering and one (1) year of experience or equivalent combination of education and experience
• Ability to work as part of a highly collaborative development team
• Ability to read and interpret technical documents such as business requirements and software specifications
• Ability to communicate effectively with internal contacts both written and oral
• Object-oriented programming and database experience are required
• Ability to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram or schedule form
• Ability to develop and document requirements and specifications
• Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or assume sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time

Preferred:
• Working knowledge of Java and SQL is a plus
